slides.title: Precedence & Associativity Overview
slides.prompt: Precedence determines which operator executes first. Associativity dictates evaluation order for operators with equal precedence.
slides.codeSnippet:
int a = 2 + 3 * 4;   // 14 (Multiplication higher than addition)
int b = 10 - 4 - 2;  // 4  (Left-to-Right associativity: (10-4)-2)
